question: Is the raw response to a gas-directed route associated with gas being misaligned with both discrete members and continuous starlight?

driver.selection_status: A_dual and the gate were proposed after observing that MACS0429 alone improved; they cannot validate P0609

claim_limits: The driver and threshold are post hoc after inspecting P0609.
Only four systems have finite matched raw responses, so p-values and jackknives are descriptive.
MACS0429 is a high-leverage point and has only two held-out images.
The candidate gate must be frozen and tested on a different cluster before it can enter the field formula.
Directional alignment uses proxy maps and is not a component mass measurement.
